base_game_loop.summary: Ashoka Eternal: paid spin on 7x5 (expands to 9 rows). A winning cluster consists of 5 or more identical symbols which are either vertically or horizontally connected.. Avalanche/tumble after wins. Bonus modes: Bonus, Super Bonus. Round ends on win cap if reached.

phases.name: Place bet and spin
phases.what_happens: Player selects bet and hits Spin (or Auto Spin). Optional: activate an X-iter mode from base game only before the drop/spin.
phases.state_changes: Bet locked; optional X-iter mode selected

phases.name: Initial symbol drop/spin
phases.what_happens: Symbols land on 7x5 (expands to 9 rows). Game-specific setup features may fire (birds, Nitro/COOL reels, collectors, etc.).
phases.ends_when: All symbols at resting positions / reels stopped

phases.name: Evaluate wins
phases.what_happens: Evaluate wins: A winning cluster consists of 5 or more identical symbols which are either vertically or horizontally connected.

phases.name: Remove winners and Avalanche
phases.what_happens: Winning symbols explode/are removed; remaining symbols fall; new symbols drop in. Continues while new wins appear.
phases.ends_when: No new winning combinations after a fill
phases.state_changes: Grid updated; avalanche chain may continue

phases.name: End-of-drop features
phases.what_happens: Resolve end-of-round features (bombs, mystery reveals, row swaps, boosters, etc.) if nothing else can happen; may resume avalanches.

phases.name: Bonus trigger check
phases.what_happens: If bonus/super-bonus trigger conditions met, enter bonus mode after resolving same-drop features. Otherwise settle base-game wins subject to win cap.
phases.state_changes: Enter bonus mode or settle base round

Game description
Ashoka Eternal is a cluster game with 5 columns by 7 rows with dropping symbols. The grid can expand up to 7 columns by 9 rows. The game comes with a multiplier wheel, multipliers, redrop feature, big symbols, blocker symbols and charged Wild symbols. 
Wining symbols adjacent to a blocker removes the blocker. Clear away all blockers and the grid will expand in 3 levels. First level 5x7 symbol grid, next level 7x7 symbol grid and last level 7x9 symbol grid.

Multiplier wheel has 12 positions. Each win turns the wheel one position.
When a multiplier activation symbol is at the top of the wheel, this activates the global multiplier for the next symbol drop.
